title: ControlPlaneCommon
description: Shared definitions for control-plane contracts (02-lld §1.3). Not an instance schema.

OrgId.description: The org an object belongs to; always the caller's, taken from the token.

ScopeRef.description: A layer of the precedence chain with its id: `org:o1`, `team:t9`, `agent:a7`, `user:u3`; `deployment` and `release` have none.

ItemRef.description: A catalog item version, `{kind}:{publisher}/{name}@{version}`. `publisher` is `pipeshub` (release), `org`, `user` or a plugin publisher; `kind` is validated against the registered domain modules, not here.

InstallationRef.description: `inst_` and a ULID; toolset and MCP instance ids from before the control plane are kept verbatim (02-lld §11.2).

Revision.description: An object's revision: compare-and-set on writes, bumped once per committed write.

ActorRef.description: Who made a change: a user, a service (by its name), or the system (migrations, release data).

LayerName.description: A layer of the precedence chain (02-lld §3.1), top to bottom: the harness policy's, re-exported as this module's LAYERS.

ApproverLevel.description: Who approves a configuration change, from the loosest up: the harness policy's, re-exported as this module's APPROVER_LEVELS.

DelegableAction.description: A control-plane action an org may delegate to team admins: the harness policy's, re-exported as this module's DELEGABLE_ACTIONS.

RemediationActor.description: Who can resolve a refusal: the person who asked, an org or team admin, the admin of the layer above, the agent's builder, the binding's owner, an approver, or the operator.

ItemKind.description: A catalog kind (`toolset`, `mcp`, `skill`, `engine`, `plugin`, …): open, validated against the registered domain modules.

SubjectRef.description: Who a grant is for: the org (its built-in assistant), a team, an agent or a user.

InstallationOwnerRef.description: Who owns an installation: the org, a team or a user.

BindingOwnerRef.description: Whose credential a binding holds: the org's, an agent's (a service account) or a user's.
